figures.finding: No collective contract sets a New Zealand director's pay: under the Screen Industry Workers Act 2022 there is no occupational contract in force for directors.

sources.said: All information for the application to initiate bargaining for an occupational contract applying to directors is available on this page. There is currently no occupational contract in force.

figures.finding: The directors' guild DEGANZ publishes a standard Feature Film Director's Agreement (17 August 2022) for directors for hire, and plans to bargain minimum rates with SPADA under the Act.

value.standardContract: DEGANZ Standard Feature Film Director's Agreement

sources.said: DEGANZ is pleased to release its updated Director’s Feature Film Agreement, which is intended for use under a Director-For-Hire situation, i.e. you are given a script to direct. … download the agreement that was released on 17 August 2022
In other words, we will be looking to set minimum rates of pay and terms and conditions for these roles across these genres of screen content.

figures.finding: DEGANZ full membership costs NZ$179 a year on income under NZ$40K, NZ$276 on NZ$40-75K and NZ$552 above, and is open to anyone who identifies as a director or editor working in New Zealand or holding residency or citizenship.

value.body: Directors and Editors Guild of Aotearoa New Zealand

sources.said: Membership of the Directors and Editors Guild of Aotearoa New Zealand is open to all who identify themselves as directors, editors and/or assistant editors working within New Zealand or holding New Zealand residency and/or citizenship, who aspire to work or continue working as such in film, television and screen content creation. … Full Member – Tier 1 (Income less than $40K) $179 $16.16 / month

figures.finding: DEGANZ recommends (it binds no one) minimum freelance rates for experienced directors: NZ$4,300 a week or NZ$1,110 a day for TV drama series, mini-series and telemovies, NZ$3,550 or NZ$920 for serials, comedies and web series, NZ$2,700 or NZ$700 for documentary and factual, plus at least 50% on international drama; for a narrative feature 2.5% of the total budget plus 5% of the producer's corridor or NZSPG equity and 5% of the producer's net profit.

plus: 5% of Producer's Corridor or Producer's NZSPG Equity
5% of Producer's Share of Net Profit

figures.applies: New Zealand, the guild's 2024 recommendation for experienced freelance directors; the director still negotiates the fee.

sources.said: The rates quoted are the recommended minimums we consider fair and commensurate for experienced freelance directors. … For Directing only we recommend: $2,700 per week (+ gst) $700 per day … Series, Mini Series, Telemovies Minimum $4,300 per week (+ gst) $1110 per day … Serials (Soaps), TV Comedies, Sitcoms, Web Series $3,550 per week (+ gst) $920 per day … For international TV drama productions we recommend charging the NZ TV drama rate plus a minimum of 50 per cent. … Feature Film: Narrative Minimum 2.5% of the total budget plus gst. PLUS 5% of the Producer’s Corridor or Producer’s NZSPG Equity PLUS 5% of the Producer’s Share of Net Profit

blockers.sought: Any guaranteed prep, shoot or cut period for New Zealand directors (DEGANZ's 2024 recommended fees are now a figure; the card only tells directors to stipulate the weeks of pre-production, production and post-production in their contract).
